cards.text: Solomon, king of Israel (1 Kings 4:1), has finished it all: the house of the LORD AND his royal palace. Everything he wanted to do, he did. Me, I've never finished a single batch without eating half the dough off the spoon first.

cards.question: With the building all done, the LORD appears to Solomon. This is the first time the LORD has ever appeared to him.

cards.text: Just like back at Gibeon (1 Kings 3:5), the LORD speaks to Solomon. And He opens with this: “I have heard your prayer and petition before Me.”

cards.question: The LORD consecrates the temple Solomon built by putting His Name there. For how long?
The LORD also tells Solomon that His eyes and His heart will be at the temple for all time.

cards.text: Then the LORD turns to Solomon himself and drops the smallest word with the BIGGEST weight: IF. If Solomon walks with a heart of integrity and uprightness, doing all God commanded and keeping His statutes and ordinances…

cards.question: God says IF Solomon walks before Him the way someone else walked. Who is that someone?
If Solomon walks before God as his father David walked, God says He will establish Solomon's royal ___ over Israel forever.

cards.text: And that's not a brand new promise. God made it to David first: “You will never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.”
Then the LORD gives the other side of that IF. What if Solomon or his sons turn away from following Him and don't keep His commandments?

cards.question: The LORD warns about Solomon or his sons turning away and not keeping His commandments. What else does He name?

answers.text: Going off to serve other gods
Moving the ark out of the temple
Building a bigger palace for himself

cards.text: If that happens, God lays out what follows. And He starts with the land He gave Israel.

cards.question: If Solomon or his sons turn away from Him, what does the LORD say He will do with Israel and the land He gave them?

answers.text: Give half of it to Tyre

cards.question: If Solomon or his sons turn away, God says He will banish from His presence the temple He sanctified for His Name.
If Solomon or his sons turn away, how will all peoples see Israel?

cards.text: Then God says that when this temple has become a heap of rubble, all who pass by it will be appalled and will hiss. This part is heavy, friend.

cards.question: What do the people passing by the rubble of the temple ask?

answers.text: Why has the LORD done this
Who will build it back up
Where did all the gold go

cards.text: And others will answer them: it's because Israel forsook the LORD their God and embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them. Because of this, the LORD has brought all this disaster upon them.

cards.question: The LORD that Israel forsook is the God who brought Israel's fathers out of the land of ___.
